title: Describing changes over time / Kɔfale bɔra don fɔlɔ ka jamana kan
bridge: Anekɛlɛnkan, kɔfale bɔra don fɔlɔ ka jamana kan, i ka sɛbɛn fɔlɔw fana ka jamana kan, i tun kɛ ka sɛbɛn fɔlɔw fana ka jamana kan, i tun kɛ ka sɛbɛn fɔlɔw fana ka jamana kan. Anekɛlɛnkan, i kɔrɔkɔfɛ kɛ ka sɛbɛn fɔlɔw fana ka jamana kan, mɛnsi kɛ ka sɛbɛn fɔlɔw fana ka jamana kan, mɛnsi kɛ ka sɛbɛn fɔlɔw fana ka jamana kan. Anekɛlɛnkan, i kɔrɔkɔfɛ kɛ ka sɛbɛn fɔlɔw fana ka jamana kan, mɛnsi kɛ ka sɛbɛn fɔlɔw fana ka jamana kan, mɛnsi kɛ ka sɛbɛn fɔlɔw fana ka jamana kan. Hispanikanw bɔra, i ka sɛbɛn fɔlɔw fana ka jamana kan, i tun kɛ ka sɛbɛn fɔlɔw fana ka jamana kan, i tun kɛ ka sɛbɛn fɔlɔw fana ka jamana kan.
rule: Kɔfale bɔra don fɔlɔ ka jamana kan: 1) Gɛt + sɛbɛn fɔlɔ (n'u bɛɛ comparatif) fɔlɔ kɔfɛ bɔra jamana kan n'u fana: 'get older', 'get better', 'get colder'. 2) Become + sɛbɛn fɔlɔ/sɛbɛn fana fɔlɔ kɔfɛ bɔra jamana kan n'u fana n'u bɛɛ formal: 'become a teacher', 'become famous'. 3) Turn + sɛbɛn fɔlɔ n'u bɛɛ sɛbɛn fana fɔlɔ kɔfɛ bɔra jamana kan n'u fana n'u bɛɛ visible: 'turn red', 'turn pale'. 4) Kɔfɛ bɔra jamana kan n'u fana n'u bɛɛ fisiki n'u bɛɛ saba, i tun kɛ ka sɛbɛn fɔlɔw fana ka jamana kan, i tun kɛ ka sɛbɛn fɔlɔw fana ka jamana kan: 'grow old', 'fall asleep'. 5) Used to fɔlɔ kɔfɛ bɔra jamana kan n'u fana n'u bɛɛ kɔfɛ bɔra jamana kan: 'I used to live here'. 6) No longer n'u bɛɛ still fɔlɔ kɔfɛ bɔra jamana kan n'u fana: 'I no longer smoke', 'I still work here'. 7) Présent parfait fɔlɔ kɔfɛ bɔra jamana kan n'u fana n'u bɛɛ présent: 'The town has changed a lot'. I kɔrɔkɔfɛ kɛ ka sɛbɛn fɔlɔw fana ka jamana kan, mɛnsi kɛ ka sɛbɛn fɔlɔw fana ka jamana kan: 'estoy cansado' i kɔrɔkɔfɛ kɛ 'I am tired' sɛbɛn fɔlɔ, mɛnsi kɛ 'I have gotten tired'.

title: Speculating and making deductions / Kɛlɛya kelen kelen ye a bɔ a ka jɔnya
bridge: Hispani kanw dɛmɛ, ‘debe de ser’ an ‘puede que sea’ b’a ra kɛlɛya kelen kelen. A ye angale kanw, ‘must’, ‘might’, ‘could’, ‘can’t’ + masaya b’a ra. ‘Must’ ye kelen kelen jɔnya la (muso kelen), ‘can’t’ ye fanga jɔnya la; ‘might’, ‘may’ ye ‘could’ ye a ka taa kelen kelen jɔnya. Taliki: ‘must not’ ala ra angale kanw k’a flɛ fanga jɔnya, tɛmɛtɛ ‘must not’ angale kanw ye fanga banna.
rule: Angale kanw, k’a bɔ kelen kelen jɔnya a tun kɔnɔ, an ka ‘must’ (kelen kelen jɔnya ni taa ye), ‘can’t’ (kelen kelen jɔnya ni taa ye minw fanga ye), ‘might’, ‘may’, ‘could’ (a ka taa kelen kelen jɔnya) b’a ra, ka k’a sɔrɔ masaya ka kɔrɔtan. K’a flɛ kɔnɔ kɔfɛ, ‘must have + masaya ka kelenw’, ‘can’t have + masaya ka kelenw’, ‘might have + masaya ka kelenw’ b’a ra. Ka k’a sɔrɔ: sɔrɔnin + modali + masaya (kɔnɔ) an modali + have + masaya ka kelenw (kɔfɛ). Fɔlɔ: Hispani kanw, ‘debe de ser’ ye ‘no puede ser’ ye fanga ye, nka, angale kanw, ‘must not be’ ala ra k’a flɛ fanga jɔnya; ‘can’t be’ b’a ra.

title: Expressing regret and hypothetical situations / Arrepenti kɛ fɛn bɔra sanji
bridge: Espagnol la, i ka kondisɔnɛli dɔnkɛrankan kɛ subjonkɔtifu ka fɔlɔ i ka fɔ a ka taara kɛ arrepenti sanji (màlà a taara 'si tuviera tiempo, iría'). Angɛlɛ kan, fasɔw bɛɛ ka taa: a ka taa a ka kɔfɛ kɔlɔsi fɔlɔ (wàlà a ka kɔlɔsi fɔlɔ) a ka 'if' tɛmɛ kan, kɛ 'would' + dɔnkɛ a ka tɛmɛ tɛmɛw kan. A ka taa a ka taara 'si tendría' a ka fɔ 'if I would have' sɛbɛn, nka, angɛlɛ kan 'if' tɛmɛ ka taa ka taa 'would' ka taa. A ka taara a ka taara a ka sanji bɔra kɔlɔsi fɔlɔw la, a ka taa a ka kɔlɔsi fɔlɔ (had + dɔnkɛ) a ka kondisɔnɛli fɔlɔw ye.
rule: Angɛlɛ B1 la, a ka taara a ka sanji kɛ fɛn bɔra (kɔndisɔnɛli kɔlɔsi) sanji la, i ka taa 'if + kɔlɔsi fɔlɔ' (wàlà 'if + kɔlɔsi ka jamana') a ka kondisɔnɛli tɛmɛ kan, kɛ 'would + dɔnkɛ fɔlɔ' a ka tɛmɛ tɛmɛw kan. Màlà a taara: 'If I had more time, I would travel.' (Si tuviera más tiempo, viajaría). Kala a taara 'were' a ka taa fɔlɔw fɔlɔ la (dɔw a ka taa 'was' a ka taa angɛlɛ jamana kɛnɛmɔgɔw la). A ka taara a ka arrepenti kɔlɔsi sanji (kɔndisɔnɛli kɔlɔsi fɔlɔ) sanji la, i ka taa 'if + kɔlɔsi fɔlɔ' (had + dɔnkɛ) kɛ 'would have + dɔnkɛ' a ka tɛmɛ tɛmɛw kan: 'If I had studied, I would have passed.' (Si hubiera estudiado, habría aprobado). I ka taa 'I wish' + kɔlɔsi fɔlɔ a ka arrepenti sanji: 'I wish I had studied.' (Ojalá hubiera estudiado). Kala a taara 'if' tɛmɛ ka taa 'would' wàlà 'will' ka taa. A ka taara a ka sanji fɔlɔw fɔlɔ la, 'were' a taara sira: 'If he were here...'.

common_error.correct_alt: If I had time, I'd go to the party.
common_error.explanation: Kɔrɔ kɛlɛ la, espagnol la i ka taara 'si tendría tiempo' (kɔndisɔnɛli), nka, angɛlɛ kan 'if' tɛmɛ ka taa 'would' ka taa. A ka kɛ a ka taara kɔlɔsi fɔlɔ (had). Kɔrɔw la ala tra, kala a taara 'if' tɛmɛ ka taa kɔlɔsi fɔlɔ (a ka sanji kɛ fɛn bɔra sanji) wàlà kɔlɔsi fɔlɔ (a ka kɔlɔsi sanji), kɛ 'would' a taara a ka tɛmɛ tɛmɛw kan.

levels.label: Second conditional (present/future hypotheticals)
levels.translation: Kɔndisɔnɛli kɔlɔsi (a ka sanji kɛ fɛn bɔra sanji)

examples.original: If I won the lottery, I would travel the world.
examples.phonetic: /ɪf aɪ wʌn ðə ˈlɑːtəri aɪ wʊd ˈtrævl ðə wɜːrld/
examples.translation: N' ka taara n' ka taa a ka saba saba, n bɛ se ka jɛmɛn jɛmɛn fɔlɔ.
examples.note: Kala a taara 'won' a ka kɔlɔsi fɔlɔ, a ka taa a ka taara 'ganó' sɛbɛn ye.

examples.original: If he were taller, he could play basketball.
examples.phonetic: /ɪf hiː wɜːr ˈtɔːlər hiː kʊd pleɪ ˈbæskɪtbɔːl/
examples.translation: N' ka taa n' ka jɔn ka kɛnɛmɔgɔ, n ka se se ka basketball ka jɔlɔ.
examples.note: Angɛlɛ jamana kɛnɛmɔgɔ la i ka taa 'were' a ka taa fɔlɔw fɔlɔ la, nka 'was' a taara saba saba angɛlɛ jamana kɛnɛmɔmɔgɔw la.

examples.original: What would you do if you had a million dollars?
examples.phonetic: /wʌt wʊd juː duː ɪf juː hæd ə ˈmɪljən ˈdɑːlərz/
examples.translation: I ni jɔn i ka taara i ka taa a ka saba saba?
examples.note: A ka taa a ka kɔlɔ a ka tɛmɛ 'would' kɛ a ka taa fɔlɔ.

examples.original: If I had known, I would have come earlier.
examples.phonetic: /ɪf aɪ hæd noʊn aɪ wʊd hæv kʌm ˈɜːrliər/
examples.translation: N' ka taara n' ka jamana a ka fɔlɔ, n bɛ se ka kɛ a ka kɔlɔsi fɔlɔ.
examples.note: I ka taa kɔlɔsi fɔlɔ (had + dɔnkɛ) 'if' tɛmɛ kan kɛ 'would have + dɔnkɛ' a ka tɛmɛ tɛmɛw kan.

examples.original: She wouldn't have missed the train if she had left home on time.
examples.phonetic: /ʃiː ˈwʊdnt hæv mɪst ðə treɪn ɪf ʃiː hæd left hoʊm ɒn taɪm/
examples.translation: A ka taara a ka taara a ka jamana a ka fɔlɔ a ka taa a ka fɛ, a bɛ se ka kɛ a ka tɛmɛ a ka tɛmɛ a ka kɔlɔsi fɔlɔ.
examples.note: I ka taa 'would not' a ka kɔlɔ 'wouldn't'.

examples.original: If we had booked in advance, we would have got a discount.
examples.phonetic: /ɪf wiː hæd bʊkt ɪn ədˈvɑːns wiː wʊd hæv ɡɒt ə ˈdɪskaʊnt/
examples.translation: N' ka taara n' ka taara n' ka jamana n' ka fɔlɔ saba saba, n bɛ se ka kɛ n ka tɛmɛ n ka tɛmɛ n ka kɔlɔsi fɔlɔ.
examples.note: Angɛlɛ britaniya la i ka taa 'got' a ka dɔnkɛ; angɛlɛ amerika la i ka taa 'gotten' saba saba.

examples.original: I wish I had studied more for the test.
examples.phonetic: /aɪ wɪʃ aɪ hæd ˈstʌdid mɔːr fər ðə test/
examples.translation: N ka taa n' ka jamana n' ka fɔlɔ saba saba a ka tɛmɛ.
examples.note: 'Wish' + kɔlɔsi fɔlɔ a ka arrepenti kɔlɔsi sanji sanji.

examples.original: I wish I could speak English fluently.
examples.phonetic: /aɪ wɪʃ aɪ kʊd spiːk ˈɪŋɡlɪʃ ˈfluːəntli/
examples.translation: N ka taa n ka se ka jamana angɛlɛ ka fɔlɔ.
examples.note: 'Could' + dɔnkɛ a ka sanji a ka jamana a ka se ka jamana.

examples.original: I wish it weren't raining today.
examples.phonetic: /aɪ wɪʃ ɪt wɜːrnt ˈreɪnɪŋ təˈdeɪ/
examples.translation: N ka taa a ka taa a ka fɛn bɛn nin kɔnɔ.
examples.note: 'Wish' + kɔlɔsi ka jamana a ka sanji a ka sanji bɔra sanji.

title: Narrating a story / Kɛlɛya kɛlɛkanw bɛɛw
bridge: Sipanilɛ, kɛlɛya kɛlɛkanw bɛɛw la, an b'a kɛ mɔgɔkɔrɔsin kanw bɛɛw dɔw dɔw la, anw ka kɛlɛya kɛlɛkanw bɛɛw dɔw dɔw bɛɛ la. A fɔlɔ, a bɔra don dɔw dɔw la, anw ka kɛlɛya kɛlɛkanw bɛɛw dɔw dɔw bɛɛ la. Kɛlɛya kɛlɛkanw bɛɛw la, an b'a kɛ mɔgɔkɔrɔsin kanw bɛɛw dɔw dɔw la, anw ka kɛlɛya kɛlɛkanw bɛɛw dɔw dɔw bɛɛ la. Kɛlɛya kɛlɛkanw bɛɛw la, an b'a kɛ mɔgɔkɔrɔsin kanw bɛɛw dɔw dɔw la, anw ka kɛlɛya kɛlɛkanw bɛɛw dɔw dɔw bɛɛ la.
rule:
Kɛlɛya kɛlɛkanw bɛɛw la, an b'a kɛ mɔgɔkɔrɔsin kanw bɛɛw dɔw dɔw la, anw ka kɛlɛya kɛlɛkanw bɛɛw dɔw dɔw bɛɛ la:
1. **Mɔgɔkɔrɔsin kanw bɛɛw** (kɛlɛya: mɔgɔ + kɛlɛya kanw, p. ej. 'kɛlɛ'); (kɛlɛya kɛlɛkanw: 'kɛlɛntaa + kɛlɛya'); (kɛlɛya kɛlɛkanw: 'kɛlɛ + mɔgɔ + kɛlɛya?'). A b'a kɛ mɔgɔkɔrɔsin kanw bɛɛw dɔw dɔw la, anw ka kɛlɛya kɛlɛkanw bɛɛw dɔw dɔw bɛɛ la.
2. **Mɔgɔkɔrɔsin kanw bɛɛw ka jamana** (were/were + kɛlɛya -ing). A b'a kɛ mɔgɔkɔrɔsin kanw bɛɛw ka jamana dɔw dɔw la, anw ka kɛlɛya kɛlɛkanw bɛɛw dɔw dɔw bɛɛ la, a bɔra don dɔw dɔw la (mɔgɔkɔrɔsin kanw bɛɛw).
3. **Mɔgɔkɔrɔsin kanw bɛɛw ka jamana** (had + kɛlɛya kanw). A b'a kɛ mɔgɔkɔrɔsin kanw bɛɛw ka jamana dɔw dɔw la, anw ka kɛlɛya kɛlɛkanw bɛɛw dɔw dɔw bɛɛ la.
4. **'Used to'** (mɔgɔ + used to + kɛlɛya kɛlɛ) mɔgɔkɔrɔsin kanw bɛɛw ka jamana dɔw dɔw la, anw ka kɛlɛya kɛlɛkanw bɛɛw dɔw dɔw bɛɛ la.
5. **'Would'** mɔgɔkɔrɔsin kanw bɛɛw ka jamana dɔw dɔw la (kɛlɛya kɛlɛkanw bɛɛw ka jamana dɔw dɔw la).
Kɛlɛya kɛlɛkanw bɛɛw ka jamana dɔw dɔw la: 'first', 'then', 'after that', 'suddenly', 'finally', etc. A b'a kɛ mɔgɔkɔrɔsin kanw bɛɛw dɔw dɔw la, anw ka kɛlɛya kɛlɛkanw bɛɛw dɔw dɔw bɛɛ la.
Kɛlɛya kɛlɛkanw bɛɛw ka jamana dɔw dɔw la: kɛlɛya kɛlɛkanw bɛɛw (go-went-gone, see-saw-seen). Kɛlɛya kɛlɛkanw bɛɛw la, an b'a kɛ mɔgɔkɔrɔsin kanw bɛɛw dɔw dɔw la, anw ka kɛlɛya kɛlɛkanw bɛɛw dɔw dɔw bɛɛ la.
Kɛlɛya kɛlɛkanw bɛɛw la, an b'a kɛ mɔgɔkɔrɔsin kanw bɛɛw dɔw dɔw la, anw ka kɛlɛya kɛlɛkanw bɛɛw dɔw dɔw bɛɛ la (mɔgɔkɔrɔsin kanw bɛɛw ka jamana dɔw dɔw la).

title: Arguing a point of view / Kɛlɛya kɛmɛkɛla ka sɔrɔ
bridge: Espagnol la, kɛlɛya kɛmɛkɛla balimaw fɔlɔ, i tun tɛ ka flɛ fɔlɔw bɛɛ minw tun be jɔnw bɛɛ se ka kanbɛlɛyɔrɔ filimuw kan. Angalɛ la, i tun tɛ ka flɛ fɔlɔw bɛɛ minw tun be jɔnw bɛɛ se ka kanbɛlɛyɔrɔ filimuw kan, o bɛɛ, i tun tɛ ka flɛ fɔlɔw bɛɛ minw tun be jɔnw bɛɛ se ka kanbɛlɛyɔrɔ filimuw kan. Kɔfɛ, angalɛ la, i tun tɛ ka flɛ fɔlɔw bɛɛ minw tun be jɔnw bɛɛ se ka kanbɛlɛyɔrɔ filimuw kan, o bɛɛ, i tun tɛ ka flɛ fɔlɔw bɛɛ minw tun be jɔnw bɛɛ se ka kanbɛlɛyɔrɔ filimuw kan. rule:
Kɛlɛya kɛmɛkɛla ka sɔrɔ B1 tɔgɔ la, fɔlɔw bɛɛ minw be se ka kanbɛlɛyɔrɔ filimuw kan:

1. **Kɛlɛya kɛmɛkɛla:** 'I think (that)...', 'I believe (that)...', 'In my opinion...', 'From my point of view...'. Tɔgɔ: 'I think that recycling is important.'
2. **Kɛlɛya sɛbɛn:** 'because', 'since', 'as'. Tɔgɔ: 'I believe we should save water because it's essential for life.'
3. **Kɛlɛya masaya:** 'should' + verb tɔgɔ (without 'to'). Tɔgɔ: 'People should use public transport more.'
4. **Kɛlɛya kɛmɛkɛla ka sɔrɔ / kɛmɛkɛla ka sɔrɔ:** 'I agree', 'I disagree', 'I agree with you', 'I don't agree'. N'a ye: 'agree' bɛɛ se ka kanbɛlɛyɔrɔ filimuw kan, o bɛɛ se ka kanbɛlɛyɔrɔ filimuw kan, o bɛɛ se ka kanbɛlɛyɔrɔ filimuw kan. Tɔgɔ: 'I agree with your idea.' (N'a ye: 'I am agree').
5. **Kɛlɛya kɛmɛkɛla ka sɔrɔ:** 'However', 'but', 'on the other hand'. Tɔgɔ: 'Some people think that, but I disagree.'

Kɛlɛya kɛmɛkɛla ka sɔrɔ, i tun tɛ ka flɛ fɔlɔw bɛɛ minw tun be jɔnw bɛɛ se ka kanbɛlɛyɔrɔ filimuw kan, o bɛɛ, i tun tɛ ka flɛ fɔlɔw bɛɛ minw tun be jɔnw bɛɛ se ka kanbɛlɛyɔrɔ filimuw kan. title: Talking about your job and career / Kɛlɛya kɔfɛ la kɛlɛya jàbininw
bridge: A taali gi ye, i sɛbɛn'n tɛ baara kɛlɛ “de” ye (trabajo de médico), nka, a yɛngɛyɛngɛsi ra, o kɛlɛni “work as” (I work as a doctor) n'a tun kɛlɛ “be” (I am a doctor). A yɛngɛyɛngɛsi fɛ, o bɛɛ la a kɛlɛbaya jàbininw kɔ (work) la jàbininw tun (job), nka, a taali gi ye, i sɛbɛn'n kɛlɛ “trabajo” ye. Kɛlɛya kɔfɛ ka sɛbɛn'n ra, a bɛɛ mɔgɔkɔrɔsi kɛlɛ, nka, a yɛngɛyɛngɛsi ra, a bɛɛ mɔgɔkɔrɔsi tɛ.
rule: Kɛlɛya kɔfɛ la kɛlɛya jàbininw ye A1 tɛmɛna ra, kɛlɛ:n- Present simple kɛlɛ jàbininw ka kɛlɛya: 'I work as a teacher' (soy profesor) n'a tun 'I am a teacher'.n- 'Work in' + ala n'a tun 'work for' + sɔɔrɔ (I work in a hospital), 'work with' + mɔgɔ n'a tun jamana (I work with children).n- Kɛlɛya jàbininw ka kɛlɛya ra, kɛlɛ 'career' (trayectoria) la 'job' (empleo específico). Tɛmɛtɛmɛ: 'I'm looking for a new job' (busco un nuevo empleo), 'She has a successful career' (ella tiene una carrera exitosa).n- Kɛlɛya kɛlɛya jàbininw n'a tun kɛlɛya jàbininw ka kɛlɛya ra, kɛlɛ 'would like to' + infinitivo (I'd like to change careers) n'a tun 'planning to' (I'm planning to look for a new job).n- Kɛlɛya kɔfɛ ka sɛbɛn'n ra, kɛlɛ 'always', 'usually', 'often', 'sometimes', 'never' kɛlɛya jàbininw ka kɛlɛya ye.

title: Describing processes / Kɔfale bɔra don fana
bridge: A taali gi, i kɛra kɔfale bɔra don fana ka se ka tɛmɛ dɔw ka 'se' (nka 'se calienta el agua') wala a ka tɛmɛ kɛmɛkulu. A taali gi, i bɔra don fana ka tɛmɛ dɔw ka 'is/are + participio' (nka 'the water is heated') ni fasodenw kɔrɔtanw kɔ 'first', 'then', 'next', 'after that', 'finally'. Kɔrɔsi kɛlɛya la, a taali gi i bɔra don fana ka tɛmɛ dɔw ka sɔrɔninw bɔra, nka 'you' wala 'they'. Kɔfale bɔra don fana ka tɛmɛ dɔw ka sɔrɔ la, i kɛra kɔfale bɔra don fana ka tɛmɛ dɔw ka sɔrɔninw bɔra, o kɔ, sɔrɔninw kɔrɔ, o kɔ, fasodenw kɔrɔtanw kɔrɔ.
rule: Kɔfale bɔra don fana ka tɛmɛ dɔw kɔ B1 la, i bɔra tɛmɛ kɛmɛkulu (kɔ adɛnw kɔrɔtanw kɔrɔ) ni se ka tɛmɛ dɔw (present passive: am/is/are + past participle) sɛbɛn caa kɛra kɔfale bɔra don fana ka tɛmɛ dɔw kɔrɔ. Tɛmɛ dɔw kɔrɔtan la: First, [object] is/are + past participle. O kɔ, i bɔra fasodenw kɔrɔtanw kɔrɔ: first, then, next, after that, later, finally. I bɔra mɔgɔkɛlɛnw (nka kɔfale bɔra don fana ka tɛmɛ dɔw) wala 'you' sɔrɔninw. Se ka tɛmɛ dɔw kɔrɔ: sɔrɔninw + 'to be' ka tɛmɛ + past participle. Nka 'The coffee is ground.' Ala ga, fasodenw kɔrɔtanw (always, usually, often) kɔrɔ i bɔra tɛmɛ kɛmɛkulu kɔrɔ, o kɔ, 'be' kɔrɔ.

title: Expressing uncertainty and possibility / A ka ɲèna kɛ a ka taa jati bɛna
bridge: A espaginu kan, subjunctivo ka adivɛrbi kɔrɔla 'quizás' ka 'tal vez' tun bɛ a ka ɲèna kɛ a ka taa jati bɛna kan. Anw, angale kan, subjunctivo tun tɛ bɛrɛ, o bɛrɛ, i ka kɛlɛya modali kɔrɔla 'might' ka 'could' wala adivɛrbi kɔrɔla 'maybe' ka 'perhaps' tun bɛ i ma kan.
rule: A ka ɲèna kɛ a ka taa jati bɛna kan angale kan: 1) Adivɛrbi: 'maybe', 'perhaps', 'probably', 'definitely' (a bɛ se ka tɛmɛ wala muso jɔn). 2) Modali kɛlɛya: 'may', 'might', 'could' a ka taa jati bɛna (may/might bɛrɛ bɛɛminɛnyumuya; could bɛrɛ bɛɛminɛfɛnya a ka kɛlɛya kan). 3) 'Must' a ka taa jati bɛna: 'She must be at home'. 4) 'be likely to' wala 'be unlikely to' a ka taa jati bɛna. A ka taa jati bɛna kɛlɛya kan, 'might not' wala 'may not' (tɛ 'could not' a ka taa jati bɛna, 'couldn't' a ka taa jati bɛna kɛlɛya kan).

title: Making formal requests / Fɔlɔsira kanu la tɛ ka kɛlɛya
bridge: Espanyɛkan, fɔlɔsira kanu la, an bena kondisɔnɛli ("¿Podría...?", "¿Sería posible...?") ka kɛlɛya. Anglekan, kondisɔnɛli ye, an bena "Would you mind...?" ka kɛlɛya, gerundi (-ing) jɔ, fɔlɔ la ani u sii ka Espanyɛkan tɛ baara. Ma sira kɛlɛya "¿Te importaría...?" ka "Would you care...?" la, fɔlɔ laban sɔrɔ kɛnɛmɔgɔn fɛ. Sira bɛɛ min fɛ ka Angle kanu fɔlɔlɔ, "please" bena jɔ ka di a kɛlɛya dɔn ani a bena jɔ ka di a kɛlɛya dɔn ye.
rule:
Angle kanu fɔlɔsira kanu la (B1 tɔgɔ), bɔ a ma ka kɛlɛya:
1. **Would you + verb base...?** – 'Would you send me the report?' (¿Podría enviarme el informe?). Kɛlɛya wɛrɛ fɛ.
2. **Could you + verb base...?** – 'Could you help me with this?' (¿Podría ayudarme con esto?). 'Would' ye, amma a tɛ mɔgɔ min fɛ.
3. **Would you mind + gerund (-ing)?** – 'Would you mind closing the window?' (¿Le importaría cerrar la ventana?). Kɛlɛya wɛrɛ fɛ, a bena jɔ ka baarakɛlɛsi. 'No, not at all' tɛ bena jɔ ka kɛlɛya min fɛ.
4. **I would like to + verb base** – 'I would like to request a refund.' (Me gustaría solicitar un reembolso). Kɛlɛya wɛrɛ fɛ, a bena jɔ ka kɛlɛya dɔn ye.
5. **Fɔlɔsira kanu kɛlɛya 'Would it be possible to...?'** – 'Would it be possible to reschedule the meeting?' (¿Sería posible reprogramar la reunión?). Kɛlɛya wɛrɛ fɛ, a bena jɔ ka kɛlɛya dɔn ye.
Sira bɛɛ min fɛ: Angle kanu fɔlɔlɔ, 'please' bena jɔ ka di a kɛlɛya dɔn ani a bena jɔ ka di a kɛlɛya dɔn ye. Ɛmɛ: 'Could you help me, please?' tɛ 'Please, could you help me?'.
